excerpts: Across all seven embedded quests (Wolf-Winter, Gallowmere, Tanner's Fever, Breaking Weir, Advocate's Case, Cold Forge, Dawn Beacon)
All six embedded quests (Wolf-Winter through The Advocate's Case)
Every quest follows an identical three-beat shape (optional prep/evidence beats, one climactic check or fight, an ending) capped at 50 points and ~130-135 minutes; only flavor and setting vary.
Every quest follows the same template (gather 2-3 evidence/prep items with checks, climactic action, permanent binary choice, score payout), which becomes predictable despite varied themes.
